hook.text: Can you prove you know a secret without revealing the secret itself? Zero-knowledge proofs say yes.

buildup.text: A zero-knowledge proof lets you verify a statement is true without sharing any underlying data.

discovery.text: Example: prove you're over 18 without revealing your birthdate, name, or any other personal information.

twist.text: Zero-knowledge proofs are already used in cryptocurrency for private transactions on public blockchains.

climax.text: A future where you prove who you are without handing over your identity is now mathematically possible.

punchline.text: Prove it's true. Reveal nothing else.

quiz.question: What can zero-knowledge proofs do?
options: Verify a statement is true without revealing the underlying data
